versions.content: Macro name: FUNC Syntax: #define FUNC(rettype, memclass) Parameters (in): r etype return type of the function m emclass classification of the function itself Parameters (out): N one -- Return value: N one -- Description: The compiler abstraction shall define the FUNC macro for the declaration and definition of functions that ensures correct syntax of function declarations as required by a specific compiler.
